meta.description: Payment release contract. A payment row is READY only if it passes every expectation; any failure HOLDS it. hold_category is the failed rule with the lowest priority number; reason lists every failed rule, most serious first, with the values involved.

inputs.payments: payments_sep_nov_2026.csv (one row per email; client_id joined from the email export via email_id)
inputs.accounts_on_file: Client Settlement Accounts on File.xlsx, sheet 'Accounts On File', joined on Client ID

meta.normalisation: Account numbers are compared as text with all whitespace removed (IBAN grouping spaces). They are never converted to numbers, so leading zeros are kept. No other characters are altered.

meta.hold_reason: bank-detail change in email: old {old_account} -> new {new_account}; confirm by call-back
client ID {client_id} not in accounts file
account {account_with_sort_code} differs from account on file {account_on_file}
currency {currency} differs from client's account currency {account_currency_on_file}
